description: One cell of a Robustness Profile grid (output/oie/robustness_profile.json) — where a result holds or breaks, printed as measured. A cell may be null: structurally uncomputable slices (e.g. trend split before the SPY series begins) are disclosed as empty, never proxied. Research classifications, not buy/sell recommendations; research and education only.
